description.value: Established in 1988, the Lighthouse Pub is a long-running waterfront pub on Wharf Avenue in Sechelt offering views of the Sechelt Inlet. It pours from 18 taps featuring local craft and house brews by Foamers' Folly, and serves a food menu ranging from daily seafood features to its well-known wings.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms an active waterfront pub at 5764 Wharf Avenue, Sechelt, BC with phone (604) 885-9494 — but the OSM node coordinates (48.7977789, -123.2014441) and OSM community tag both place this record near Sidney, BC, roughly 90 km from Sechelt. This is a serious geographic mismatch suggesting the URL was incorrectly matched to this OSM node. The website makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities.
